charts.title: TOI-5726 b: orbits around TOI-5726
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5726's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5726 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Crossfield et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169...89C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CROSSFIELD_ET_AL_2025): P 5.491125215 d
